$comment: Praia do Jerivá (PRAIA-PLAN.md 1.6): the three beach terrains (sand, the sea with its foam edge, the pier deck) and every praia/* piece, authored in custom/praia.mjs (one derive that emits all of them, the boats' overheads and the lit overlays). praia/* frames pack into their own `praia` atlas (the outdoor atlas is at the 1024 x 2048 cap). Fish, junk and kiosk icons are DOM images.
